Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0423461 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Regarding the issue of HMI black screen problem, Please check the following below:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Update the Dlogic firmware, if its not done in past.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board.
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If the still persists after all the verification we suggest you in replacing the control panel with generation2. Please find the below MLFB number for the same.
1. 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 : Adaptation Set
2. Control Panel MLFB below, Based on the charger's HMI configuration you can order accordingly.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
